name: fdos
description: A persistent identifier (nfdi:NFDI_0001037, digital object identifier) is a first-class individual that is part-of the object it identifies via obo:BFO_0000050 and carries its resolvable address through nfdi:NFDI_0001008 (has url). The identifier is therefore describable in its own right rather than being a literal on the dataset.
competency_questions: Which FAIR Digital Objects has NFDI-MatWerk registered?; What is the persistent identifier of a given FDO, and which dataset does it denote?
